title: 第25章 冒充卧底第26章 林越归来
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 傍晚时分。
洞府内的各种能补充元气的灵药，基本被榨干，只剩零星几朵高阶药草尚有一丝药力残余。
随着李牧火周身气血一震，药圃里枯萎的灵药便尽数化作齑粉，什么都没能留下。
现在的问题是，自己若想回到炼器坊，似乎就只有一个办法了，冒充纪欢。
毕竟，以李牧火展现出来的真实修为，是根本不可能在纪欢手下存活的。
但是，冒充纪欢并不简单，因为自己继承纪欢的记忆并不完整，比如此人的人际关系这些，竟是一片空白。
甚至，就连卧底期间纪欢接触过的人，也全无记忆。
若他猜测得不错，可能这部分记忆在主体神魂之中，被自己一刀给湮灭掉了。
这一点很麻烦，因为他根本不知道纪欢的人脉网络，这就很被动。
比如有炼魔宗卧底出现了，自己本该认识，却不认识了，到时候必然会引起怀疑。
正当李牧火苦恼之际，他感受到了此间阵法波动。
是的，自打融合了纪欢的部分记忆后，李牧火同样也继承了纪欢对阵法的掌握和理解，虽有大量缺失，但已经相当不俗。
“纪前辈。”
山洞外，一道声音响起。
李牧火立刻分辨出，这便是昨夜那黑衣人的声音。
这声音明显经过刻意扭曲，像是多种声音混合般，所以李牧火立刻就认了出来。
这一瞬间，李牧火生出了毁尸灭迹的念头。
如果只是此人与王北川合谋，并无其他人知晓的话，只要杀了此人和王北川，自己便依然可以当一个正常的玄天宗弟子。
唯一的难点就是王北川的失踪，这有可能让整个青竹炼器坊被重点核查甚至长期备受关注。
不过，李牧火还是忍住了，以防万一，他还是得确定一下才行。
“进来！”
李牧火开口说道。
然而，那人并未进来，而是默默祭出了兵器。
李牧火这才反应过来，纪欢已经被自己干掉了，所以方才开口是以自己的声音说的，此人定是发现声音不对。
李牧火当即道：“别紧张，老夫已将此子夺舍。”
“夺舍？”
这人犹豫了一下，竟直接信了，径直走了进来。
今日这人没穿黑衣，而是穿着玄天宗外门弟子服饰，脸上也并未遮掩。
然而，当李牧火看见此人的刹那，瞳孔便骤然一缩。
“康宵？”
是的，此人赫然就是在炼器坊坐镇一年之久的康宵，他还曾指导过自己练刀呢。
在看到李牧火后，康宵拱手行礼道：“纪前辈，主上一直在为您物色夺舍对象，您为何选择了此子？他不过是一个炼器坊的杂役弟子而已，只是在炼器方面略有天赋而已。”
却见李牧火淡然一笑：“非也。我探查过此人，虽然修行资质低劣，但却是罕见的炼体天才，玄天宗瞎了眼才将他充作杂役弟子。而且，此子是炼器师，还如此年轻，老夫以前就一直在思考阵法该与炼器结合，如今恰逢此人，又怎会放过？”
“炼体天才？”
康宵回忆起李牧火凭铁骨功三年晋升淬体四重的表现，似乎也真有这个可能，此前自己竟没注意此事。
“好了，既然已经夺舍，便由老夫冒充此人。正好也可以在炼器坊印证一下老夫的一些阵法思路。”
content_en:
Late afternoon.
All kinds of elixirs that can replenish vitality in the cave have been basically drained, leaving only a few high-level herbs with a trace of medicinal power remaining.
As Li Muhuo's energy and blood shook, all the withered elixirs in the medicine garden turned into powder, leaving nothing behind.
The problem now is that if he wants to return to the weapon refining workshop, there seems to be only one way to pretend to be Ji Huan.
After all, with Li Muhuo's true cultivation level, it was impossible to survive under Ji Huan's hands.
However, it is not easy to pretend to be Ji Huan, because the memory of Ji Huan he inherited is incomplete, such as this person's interpersonal relationships, and so on.
Even the people Ji Huan came into contact with during his undercover period had no memory.
If his guess is correct, this part of the memory may be in the main body's soul and was annihilated by his own knife.
This was very troublesome because he didn't know Ji Huan's network at all, so he was very passive.
For example, if an undercover agent of the Demon Refining Sect appears, and he should know him, but he doesn't, it will inevitably arouse suspicion.
Just when Li Muhuo was distressed, he felt the fluctuations in the formation here.
Yes, since merging part of Ji Huan's memories, Li Muhuo has also inherited Ji Huan's mastery and understanding of battle techniques. Although there are a lot of shortcomings, they are already quite good.
"Senior Ji."
A voice sounded outside the cave.
Li Muhuo immediately recognized that this was the voice of the man in black last night.
The voice was obviously deliberately distorted, like a mixture of multiple voices, so Li Muhuo recognized it immediately.
At this moment, Li Muhuo had the idea of ​​destroying the corpse and eradicating traces.
If it was just this person who conspired with Wang Beichuan and no one else knew about it, as long as he killed this person and Wang Beichuan, he could still be a normal Xuantian Sect disciple.
The only difficulty is Wang Beichuan's disappearance, which may put the entire Qingzhu Weapon Refining Workshop under intense scrutiny and even draw attention for a long time.
However, Li Muhuo still held back, just in case, he still had to make sure.
"Come in!"
Li Muhuo said.
However, the man did not come in, but silently sacrificed his weapon.
Only then did Li Muhuo realize that Ji Huan had been killed by him, so he had spoken in his own voice. This person must have realized that his voice was wrong.
Li Muhuo immediately said: "Don't be nervous, I have already taken this son away."
"Seize the body?"
The man hesitated for a moment, then believed it and walked straight in.
Today, this man was not wearing black clothes, but was wearing the clothes of an outer disciple of the Xuantian Sect, and his face was not covered.
However, the moment Li Muhuo saw this person, his pupils suddenly shrank.
"Kang Xiao?"
Yes, this person was clearly Kang Xiao, who had been in charge of the weapon refining workshop for a year, and he had also guided him in sword practice.
After seeing Li Mu Huo, Kang Xiao raised his hands and saluted: "Senior Ji, the Lord has been looking for a partner for you, why did you choose this boy? He is just a handyman disciple in the weapon refining workshop, and he only has a slight talent in weapon refining."
But Li Muhuo smiled calmly: "No. I have investigated this person. Although his cultivation qualifications are poor, he is a rare body-refining genius. The Xuantian Sect was blind and passed him off as a handyman disciple. Moreover, this man is a weapon refiner, and he is still so young. I have been thinking about how to combine the formation with the weapon refining before. Now that I happen to meet this person, how can I let him go?"
"Physical refining genius?"
Kang Xiao recalled Li Muhuo's performance in advancing to the fourth level of body tempering in three years with his Iron Bone Kung Fu. It seemed that this was really possible, but he had not paid attention to it before.
"Okay, now that the body has been seized, I will pretend to be this person. It just so happens that I can confirm some of my formation ideas in the weapon refining workshop."
